text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Errr... ah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...What a coincidence, Trainer. 
Out on an evening stroll? Actually, I was just――
choice_data_list: You don't look like you're here to take a walk.
You don't look like you're here to take a walk.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's...
choice_data_list: Are you worried, about the Selection Race?
Are you worried, about the Selection Race?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I am the star who brings about "miracles"! 
That's...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, forgive me... I didn't mean to raise my voice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haah... 
I suppose you saw right through my composure. Still got a 
ways to go, it seems.

Smiling a little awkwardly, Fuji Kiseki took a deep breath and 
spoke calmly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The Debut Race is a special stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Only those ready to truly run as Umamusume, 
prepared to take their first step toward the Twinkle Series, 
may step onto that turf――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it's nothing like mock races before. 
The expectations and caliber of competitors are worlds apart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yet, I――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, how have I looked so far? 
Did I present the show of a confident, brilliant "Fuji Kiseki" 
overflowing with talent?
choice_data_list: It sure looked that way to me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd be glad if so. I always strive to be that way.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But... truth is, it isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today was no different. Had I watched that girl more closely, 
she wouldn't have slipped out of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even now... knowing I must rest, thinking of tomorrow... 
I simply cannot keep still...

Fuji Kiseki fell silent, an anxious look on her face. 
Unless she clears her mind, she might continue to push herself 
too far.

What can we do for her...? 
How can we cheer up the one who aspires to be an 
entertainer――?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So long as an audience expects "Miracle Kiseki," 
it is the star's duty to deliver her utmost.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What? Ah... Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! 
That look... Did ya manage to find Fuji?
choice_data_list: Yeah, about that, I need a little favor.
Yeah, about that, I need a little favor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? A favor...?
choice_data_list: I wanted to ease her worries.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Alright, spill it.

I explained the situation to Hishi Amazon and asked for her 
cooperation. 
Then――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! 
What are you doing he... Wait, eh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone, why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't help it. Trainer here asked me to round up the crowd 
to cheer you on for your Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then more and more kept piling in... 
All ready to write apology slips for breaking curfew. Bunch of softies.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai, did you really sneak in extra training? That's our hero! 
You're always swooping in to save the day!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, I'm shouting "Senpai, go for it!" with all my power!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya too, Maya too! Your races are super cool! 
I'll be cheering with tons of fun!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai! You can do it! 
Fuji-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone...
choice_data_list: Everyone, and I, believe in your "Kiseki Miracle."
Everyone, and I, believe in your "Kiseki Miracle."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My "Kiseki Miracle"...
choice_data_list: So you, too, must believe in your "miracle."
So you, too, must believe in your "miracle."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. You got me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't show these girls anything unsightly. No, I refuse to let them see me waver.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let us return――chins up, smiles ready.
Thus, Fuji Kiseki returned to the dormitory and rested.
Then, the next morning, in the Debut Race, she――

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the third turn! Sweeping up from the outside like lightning... 
The "Black Meteor" Fuji Kiseki! Overcoming a rough start!

text_block_list.name: Junior Students
text_block_list.text: Senpai, go get 'em———!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Not all doubt is gone. After all, I'm still a 
novice... far from the true "Fuji Kiseki.")

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even so――I stand before an audience! Before those watching eyes! 
As the Entertainer, I will never abandon my pride!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki takes the lead down the final stretch! The 
gap to second place is a massive eight lengths! A true solo performance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Ignore the burn, keep it suave and smile! That is "Fuji Kiseki"! 
Come, enchant them all till the very end...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Behold――my "Kiseki Miracle"!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki crosses the line in first place! 
A roaring ovation for a breathtaking masterclass!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki-senpai, thank you... for such an amazing race. 
Because of you, I remembered my own dream!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Goodness, that wore me out. 
I rarely get sore, but tomorrow might test me.
choice_data_list: Good job, we saw a great "Kiseki Miracle" out there.
Good job, we saw a great "Kiseki Miracle" out there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I used to think audience expectations were heavy burdens to bear... 
Yet――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They can also become greatest source of strength. 
...You taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would you... 
continue to guide me from here on?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Together, I know we can deliver even more dazzling "Miracles" to everyone...!

Thus, I formed an official contract with Fuji Kiseki, the star 
who brings wonder to all...!
